shortDescription: Manage project-level merge request approvals settings on GitLab Server

options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: approvals_before_merge
options.description: The number of approvals required before a merge request can be merged. Deprecated in GitLab 12.3.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request
options.displayName: Disable Overriding Approvers Per Merge Request
options.description: Disable overriding approvers per merge request.

options.name: merge_requests_author_approval
options.description: Allow authors to self-approve merge requests.

options.name: merge_requests_disable_committers_approval
options.description: Prevent committers from approving merge requests.

options.name: project
options.description: The name or full path of the GitLab project.

options.name: require_password_to_approve
options.description: Require password reauthentication to approve a merge request. Deprecated in GitLab 16.9.

options.name: require_reauthentication_to_approve
options.description: Require user reauthentication to approve a merge request.

options.name: selective_code_owner_removals
options.description: Reset approvals from Code Owners if their files are changed.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.
